title: Add a mounted guard after the awaited date-picker calls in SelfPacedGoalStep._pickDeadline
why: Both branches of _pickDeadline call setState() straight after an awaited date-picker dialog with no `if (!mounted) return;` guard, unlike every other async-gap-then-setState in this same batch (step_starting_position.dart:89/114, step_starting_position_calendar.dart:97-98/100, step_scope.dart:150) which all check mounted first. If the user backs out of the Add-Track wizard while the date picker is open, the awaited Future resolves after State.dispose(), and setState() throws (framework error, not silently ignored) instead of the no-op the mounted guard would produce. This needs a runtime repro (rapid back-navigation during either date picker) to confirm it fires in practice, but the code path is unambiguous.
recommendation: Add `if (!mounted) return;` immediately after each `await ...Picker.show/showLearningAppDatePicker(...)`, matching the guard style already used elsewhere in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: Both await sites in _pickDeadline check mounted before calling setState.
A widget test that disposes SelfPacedGoalStep while the picker Future is pending does not throw.
